# The import root is a boundary the filesystem holds, not a path prefix: the
# project is read through an os.Root, so a symlink inside it that points out of
# it escapes no more than `..` does. md: and file: each checked the path they
# were given and then followed whatever it named.
env SNGL_GENCACHE=off
symlink proj/doc.md -> ../outside/doc.md
symlink proj/out -> ../outside
symlink proj/assets/link.txt -> ../../outside/secret.txt
symlink proj/shared -> ../outside/lib

# md: a document that is a link to one outside the root.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out proj/md.sngl
stderr 'import "md:./doc.md": md: reading "./doc.md": .*path escapes'
! exists out/index.html

# file: an asset directory that is a link to a directory outside the root.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out proj/dir.sngl
stderr 'file: import "out" escapes project directory through a symlink'

# file: an asset inside the directory that is a link to a file outside it. Not
# a missing file, which would leave the call unfolded and render nothing.
! sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out proj/file.sngl
stderr 'file: link.txt in proj/assets is a link to something outside it'
! exists out/index.html

# A directory import may still leave the root -- `../lib` always could, and a
# symlink to a directory is read the same way -- since only a plugin's reads are
# held to it.
sngl generate --lang=none --platform=html -o out-lib proj/lib.sngl
grep 'from the shared library' out-lib/index.html

-- outside/secret.txt --
the outside's secret
-- outside/doc.md --
# Outside
-- outside/lib/lib.sngl --
// What every project shares.
const greeting = "from the shared library"
-- proj/assets/keep.txt --
kept
-- proj/md.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import d "md:./doc.md"

ui.window(title="t") {
    d.document()
}
-- proj/dir.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import a "file:out"

const v = a.contents("secret.txt")

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=v)
}
-- proj/file.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import a "file:assets"

const v = a.contents("link.txt")

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=v)
}
-- proj/lib.sngl --
import ui "sngl:ui"
import l "./shared"

ui.window(title="t") {
    ui.text(value=l.greeting)
}
